purpose: Determine whether the existing Chapter 2 comparative universe can support an outcome-independent external prediction challenge of conditional response geometry, without changing the frozen synthetic model or reclassifying published outcomes to improve fit.

chronology_boundary.allowed_claim: prospective-like only where an earlier repository freeze demonstrably preceded calculation of the exact target; all other fitted or projected comparisons are retrospective
chronology_boundary.forbidden_claim: this 2026-08-28 audit cannot retrospectively convert known literature outcomes into independent prospective predictions

target_contract.target: direction or preregistered ordinal state of a post-establishment plant functional-service or reproductive response to an observed interaction reorganization
target_contract.unit_of_independence: named island-system or archipelago transition cluster; nested plants, islands, sites, seasons, taxa and contrasts do not increase independent system n

model_derived_control_axes.name: turnover_imbalance
model_derived_control_axes.definition: T = z_loss - z_arrival, where each z is centered and divided by its declared synthetic range; positive T is loss-dominated and negative T is arrival-dominated
model_derived_control_axes.derivation: The fixed ten-parameter transition-surface diagnostic gave sign-stable positive association for partner loss and sign-stable negative association for partner arrival. No empirical outcomes enter this axis definition.
model_derived_control_axes.empirical_minimum: source-defined loss and arrival/replacement quantities on the same transition unit, or a directionally explicit source-derived proxy; richness change alone is insufficient

model_derived_control_axes.name: source_functional_displacement
model_derived_control_axes.definition: D0 = (plant_source_position - partner_source_centre) / partner_source_scale, using a source-defined SD, IQR or bounded functional range fixed before the target
model_derived_control_axes.derivation: The matching equation depends on distance between plant and partner functional positions, and the frozen response geometry varies over plant starting position.
model_derived_control_axes.empirical_minimum: matched source plant and partner functional traits in commensurate units; island outcome values may not define the centre or scale

model_derived_control_axes.name: realized_community_shift
model_derived_control_axes.definition: C = (partner_target_centre - partner_source_centre) / partner_source_scale, accompanied by source-native richness, functional-diversity and turnover descriptors rather than substituted by any one of them
model_derived_control_axes.derivation: Matched-community simulations and the fixed decomposition show that realized pollinator community is a distinct control layer from starting position.
model_derived_control_axes.empirical_minimum: source and target partner composition plus functional traits or a prespecified functional-shift proxy on the same plant-system transition

model_derived_control_axes.name: local_filtering
model_derived_control_axes.definition: F = 1 - realized_positive_opportunity / feasible_positive_opportunity on a prespecified support or weighted-opportunity scale; higher F denotes stronger local removal
model_derived_control_axes.derivation: The frozen local projection can only remove active plants, pollinators or feasible pairs, and its direction-specific diagnostics show asymmetric branch reallocation.
model_derived_control_axes.empirical_minimum: a source-defined feasible or regional opportunity set and a matched realized local interaction set; observed richness alone is insufficient

downstream_modifier.name: reproductive_assurance
downstream_modifier.role: reported separately from the four sign-regime axes
downstream_modifier.reason: The frozen assurance envelope changed decline magnitude but produced zero sign rescues; it must not be used to tune or rescue a response-sign classifier.
downstream_modifier.empirical_minimum: direct autonomous fruit or seed production, controlled dependency, or another source-native assurance measure

competing_hypotheses.label: universal_one_direction
competing_hypotheses.prediction: all admitted systems share one response direction fixed before holdout evaluation

competing_hypotheses.label: starting_state_only
competing_hypotheses.prediction: response varies with source functional displacement without using target community realization
competing_hypotheses.claim_boundary: synthetic coordinate thresholds cannot be exported to an empirical trait without an outcome-independent mapping

competing_hypotheses.label: turnover_regime_only
competing_hypotheses.prediction: more loss-dominated turnover increases the probability or extent of negative response regardless of plant starting state

competing_hypotheses.label: starting_state_by_realized_community
competing_hypotheses.prediction: the prespecified matching projection abs(D0) - abs(D0 - C) predicts response direction better than H0, H1 or H2

competing_hypotheses.label: starting_state_by_community_plus_local_filtering
competing_hypotheses.prediction: a prespecified local opportunity projection improves held-out response classification beyond H3
competing_hypotheses.claim_boundary: the synthetic filtering-strength values are not empirical thresholds and may not be selected by fit

availability_vocabulary.direct_measurement: source reports the required quantity on the matched prediction unit
availability_vocabulary.source_derived_proxy: quantity can be derived by a rule fixed independently of the response outcome, but is not a direct measurement of the model variable
availability_vocabulary.unavailable: the source does not expose the required quantity on the matched unit
availability_vocabulary.not_applicable: the field is outside the source system's declared estimand

admission_classes.admissible_prospective_like_challenge: predictor mapping and exact target were frozen before target calculation, the Chapter 2 target contract is met, and the required model inputs are available on one matched transition unit
admission_classes.retrospective_explanatory_test_only: a model projection can be reconstructed, but published outcome knowledge, same-source target construction, or post-outcome mapping prevents an independent prediction claim
admission_classes.reality_boundary_only: the source supports a response state or mechanism boundary but lacks a comparable outcome or one or more indispensable predictors
admission_classes.source_gated_unusable: essential source bytes, tables, units or provenance are not currently recoverable

formal_evaluation_gate.minimum_basis: the repository's pre-existing Tier-B leave-one-system-out design uses four systems as the minimum first transfer test; this is a floor, not evidence of broad generality
required_for_level3: at least four geographically de-duplicated system clusters share one comparable response target
the same clusters expose D0, T or C as required for H1-H3 without using outcome values to define the mapping
predictor and response units are matched
H0, H1, H2 and H3 can all be evaluated on the same admitted clusters
no missing input is imputed from response state
required_for_level4: leave-one-system-out and leave-one-archipelago-cluster-out evaluation without system replacement
the frozen H3 or H4 rule has lower held-out error than H0 and both simpler conditional alternatives
an exact system-label permutation test is reported where its resolution is adequate
formal_evaluation_gate.if_gate_fails: do not fit H0-H4, do not report cross-system accuracy, and freeze the result as not_evaluable

prohibited_interpretations: 25 or more research entries as independent systems
published response examples as mechanistic validation
raw Izu matching as non-random partner sorting beyond community composition
starting position alone as a universal response determinant
synthetic parameter or design-point frequencies as natural prevalence
Chapter 3 phenotype as causal validation of the Chapter 2 pollinator mechanism
missing predictors reconstructed from known response categories
post-hoc system deletion, replacement, axis redefinition, threshold selection or parameter tuning
